auth.verify_email.title: Confirm your email address
auth.verify_email.subject: Jappo — confirm your email address
auth.verify_email.body:
Hello {{fullName}},

Welcome to Jappo. Confirm your email address by opening this link:
{{link}}

This link expires in 48 hours.

auth.password_reset.title: Password reset
auth.password_reset.subject: Jappo — reset your password
auth.password_reset.body:
Hello {{fullName}},

To choose a new password, open this link:
{{link}}

This link expires in 1 hour. If you did not request this, ignore this message.

auth.otp.title: Login code
auth.otp.sms: Jappo: your code is {{code}}. It expires in 5 minutes. Do not share it.

member.invited.title: Invitation to join {{orgName}}
member.invited.subject: Jappo — invitation to join {{orgName}}
member.invited.body:
Hello,

{{inviterName}} invites you to join {{orgName}} on Jappo (roles: {{roles}}).
Accept the invitation: {{link}}

This link expires in 7 days.

org.kyc_submitted.title: KYC submitted: {{orgName}}
org.kyc_submitted.subject: Jappo — KYC to review: {{orgName}}
org.kyc_submitted.body: {{orgName}} has submitted its KYC documents. Review them in the admin console: {{link}}

org.kyc_verified.title: Your organisation is verified
org.kyc_verified.subject: Jappo — {{orgName}} is verified
org.kyc_verified.body: Good news: the KYC verification of {{orgName}} is approved. All features are now available.

org.kyc_rejected.title: KYC verification rejected
org.kyc_rejected.subject: Jappo — KYC verification of {{orgName}} rejected

rfp.invited.title: New opportunity: {{blockName}}
rfp.invited.subject: Jappo — tender {{rfpRef}} ({{blockName}})
rfp.invited.body:
Your profile matches dossier {{dossierRef}} ({{blockName}}, score {{score}}/100).
Requested amount: {{amount}}.
Deadline: {{deadline}}.
View the opportunity: {{link}}

rfp.extended.title: Deadline extended: {{rfpRef}}
rfp.extended.subject: Jappo — {{rfpRef}}: new deadline
rfp.extended.body: The deadline of tender {{rfpRef}} is extended to {{deadline}}. {{link}}

rfp.question_published.title: New answer published: {{rfpRef}}
rfp.question_published.subject: Jappo — {{rfpRef}}: Q&A
rfp.question_published.body: An answer was published in the Q&A of {{rfpRef}}. {{link}}

rfp.closed.title: Tender closed: {{rfpRef}}
rfp.closed.subject: Jappo — {{rfpRef}} closed ({{bids}} bid(s))
rfp.closed.body: Tender {{rfpRef}} closed with {{bids}} bid(s). The evaluation is available: {{link}}

award.proposed.title: Award proposed: {{rfpRef}}
award.proposed.subject: Jappo — award of {{amount}} on {{rfpRef}}
award.proposed.body: The operator awards you {{amount}} on {{rfpRef}} ({{blockName}}). Accept or decline: {{link}}

award.not_awarded.title: Bid not selected: {{rfpRef}}
award.not_awarded.subject: Jappo — {{rfpRef}}: bid not selected
award.not_awarded.body: Your bid on {{rfpRef}} was not selected. Thank you for participating.

award.accepted.title: Award accepted: {{lenderName}}
award.accepted.subject: Jappo — {{lenderName}} accepts {{amount}}
award.accepted.body: {{lenderName}} accepted the award of {{amount}} on {{rfpRef}}. Next step: contracts. {{link}}

award.declined.title: Award declined: {{lenderName}}
award.declined.subject: Jappo — {{lenderName}} declines {{rfpRef}}
award.declined.body: {{lenderName}} declined the award on {{rfpRef}}. Reason: {{reason}}. You can re-award the amount: {{link}}
